notes: Runs are sequential on the same GPU, with no competing validation workloads.
Timing pairs are p50/p95 milliseconds. CPU, RSS and GPU summary pairs are median/peak.
CPU covers the Elsewhere process; one core is 100 percent. GPU counters cover the device.
Readback includes pending GPU compositing, map and row copy.
Per-viewer decode counters are independent. Conversion/encoding timings pool all stream workers.
NVENC uses a nominal 60 Hz compositor; explicit CPU encoding uses 30 Hz. This compares the supported modes at their respective source rates.
